environment: VLC 3.0.24 on Omarchy. Initial Open/cancel ran on real XWayland. Subsequent native workflow input/captures used a private authenticated Xvfb display, generated media, isolated config and silent Pulse sink. APIs supplied state readbacks; setup via API is called out.

checks.detail: Clicked the original Open key. Actual Qt Open Media dialog appeared; Escape canceled and left the playlist empty.

checks.name: Native single-file Open
checks.detail: Selected generated Alpha in the real file picker and activated Play in the native Open Media dialog. Actual VLC reports Playing, 60s and exact file URI.

checks.name: Native Stop and Quit

checks.name: Native seek and transport

checks.name: Native named playlist reopen

checks.name: Partial per-file and finish handoff

checks.name: Native queue boundaries
checks.detail: Two-item Next selected Bravo; another Next did not select unrelated media (immediate readback retained the last item). With an empty queue, native Next/Previous/Stop left it empty and stopped. Play did not fabricate an item; any Open prompt was canceled.

checks.name: Final rotary hit-region regression
checks.detail: After the hit-region fix, original knob still changed real Pulse stream volume to about 167% and back to 100%; Full then entered fullscreen while preserving volume. No artwork was redrawn.

checks.name: Native manual end boundary
checks.detail: With two stable inputs, original Next moved Alpha → Bravo → Alpha. VLC manual Next wraps to the first item even when automatic loop is off. The test expectation was corrected from Stop to this actual policy; empty-queue behavior was checked separately.
checks.method: User-approved isolated X11 input and actual VLC readbacks
